note_text:
CC: new heel pain after long walk

HPI: weeks of symptoms relating to extensive callus burden with pain on ambulation. PMH: Type 2 diabetes mellitus.

Exam: plantar callus area consistent with extensive callus burden with pain on ambulation; general inspection of the foot otherwise unremarkable.

MDM: addressed the procedure as well as a separate complaint; considered conservative options for the separate complaint and deferred a decision.

Procedure: Paring of extensive hyperkeratotic lesions performed (LT and RT modifiers documented). Tolerated well, no immediate complications.
